description: Add owner payment-verification to the Filament admin (/admin) and an end-to-end feature test. In the Bookings admin, show the payment method and the uploaded proof image, and add Approve / Reject actions. Approve activates the booking and occupies the room and marks the Payment success; Reject sets the booking back to pending (not active) and marks the Payment failed with an optional reason. Depends on FEAT-002 (Payment rows, payment_method, verified_at/notes columns, status 'review') and FEAT-001 (working registration for the e2e test). Edit BookingResource.php directly — it defines form()/table() INLINE and does NOT use its Tables/Schemas stub classes (see context.json directory_structure).
steps: In app/Filament/Resources/Bookings/BookingResource.php table(): keep the existing proof_of_payment ImageColumn (disk 'public') so the owner can see the proof. Add a column showing the payment method derived from the latest related Payment (e.g. TextColumn::make('payments.payment_method') via a latestPayment relation, or a getStateUsing closure reading $record->payments()->latest()->first()?->payment_method). Keep the existing status badge/colors (pending/review/active/cancelled). Add 'on_site'/'bank_transfer' friendly labels where the method is shown.

Add a Payment relation helper on App\Models\Booking if convenient: a latestPayment() hasOne for display (optional; payments() hasMany already exists). Keep $guarded = [] and the booted() deleted hook unchanged.

In BookingResource.php recordActions(): add two actions using Filament\Actions\Action and Filament\Notifications\Notification, each visible only when $record->status === 'review'. APPROVE: within a DB transaction set booking status='active', set the booking's room status='occupied', set the latest Payment status='success' and verified_at=now(); then Notification::make()->success()->title('Pembayaran disetujui')->send(). REJECT: present an Action form Textarea 'reason' (nullable), set booking status='pending' (do NOT activate), set latest Payment status='failed' and notes=reason; Notification::make()->warning()->title('Pembayaran ditolak')->send(). Keep the existing EditAction. Match the Filament 5 API already used in ServiceRequestResource.php.
Do NOT change User::canAccessPanel() (owner/staff only). Do NOT switch BookingResource to the stale Tables/BookingsTable.php or Schemas/BookingForm.php stubs.

Create tests/Feature/ManualPaymentFlowTest.php (uses Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase; runs on sqlite; follow the style of tests/Feature/Auth/RegistrationTest.php). Cover: (a) POST /register then assert the created user role='customer' and GET /dashboard returns 200; (b) create a RoomType + Room (status 'available') + a Booking for the user, GET /booking/{booking}/pay returns 200 and contains the dummy account number from config('payment.bank'); (c) POST checkout bank_transfer with Storage::fake('public') and UploadedFile::fake()->image('proof.jpg') — assert booking status 'review', Payment row (bank_transfer, pending), proof stored and bookings.proof_of_payment set; (d) second booking POST checkout on_site — assert status 'review', Payment (on_site, pending), no proof; (e) approve: replicate the action's updates (booking active, room occupied, Payment success + verified_at) and assert; (f) reject: Payment failed + notes set and booking pending, and assert the room is NOT occupied by the rejected booking.
Run the full suite and a fresh seed to confirm no regressions in admin access or seeders.
acceptance_criteria: At /admin as owner@arca.com, a booking with status 'review' shows the uploaded proof image and the payment method, and offers Approve and Reject actions (hidden for non-review bookings).
Approve sets booking status='active', the room status='occupied', and the latest Payment status='success' with verified_at set.
Reject sets booking status='pending' (never 'active') and the latest Payment status='failed', storing the optional reason in payments.notes.
tests/Feature/ManualPaymentFlowTest.php passes and the full `php artisan test` suite is green.
`php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` succeeds; owner@arca.com can still log into /admin and a seeded customer into /dashboard.
findings:
Implemented owner payment-verification in the Filament Bookings admin and an end-to-end feature test.

FILES CHANGED:
- app/Models/Booking.php: added latestPayment() hasOne relation (hasOne(Payment::class)->latestOfMany()) for display. payments() hasMany, $guarded=[], and the booted() deleted hook left unchanged.
- app/Filament/Resources/Bookings/BookingResource.php: edited the INLINE table()/recordActions() (did NOT touch the stale Tables/Schemas stubs). (a) Added a 'payment_method' badge TextColumn using getStateUsing(fn(Booking $record)=> $record->latestPayment?->payment_method) with friendly labels 'Transfer Bank'/'Bayar di Tempat' (bank_transfer/on_site) and colors info/gray; kept the existing proof_of_payment ImageColumn (disk 'public') and the status badge/colors. (b) Added two Filament\Actions\Action record actions, each visible only when $record->status==='review': APPROVE (OutlinedCheckCircle, success, requiresConfirmation) runs a DB::transaction setting booking status='active', room status='occupied', latest Payment status='success' + verified_at=now(), then Filament\Notifications\Notification::make()->success()->title('Pembayaran disetujui'); REJECT (OutlinedXCircle, danger, requiresConfirmation) exposes a schema([Textarea 'reason' nullable]) and in a DB::transaction sets booking status='pending' (never active) and latest Payment status='failed' + notes=reason, then Notification::make()->warning()->title('Pembayaran ditolak'). Kept the existing EditAction. New imports: Filament\Actions\Action, Filament\Forms\Components\Textarea, Filament\Notifications\Notification, Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB. Did NOT change User::canAccessPanel().
- database/migrations/2026_05_13_141540_create_bookings_table.php: added 'review' to the status enum list. REQUIRED FIX: on sqlite (test DB) the base enum() becomes a CHECK constraint lacking 'review', so any update to status='review' threw 'CHECK constraint failed: status'. The pgsql-only fix migrations (2026_05_20_085218 / 2026_06_15_000002) self-skip on sqlite, so they did not cover the base constraint. Adding 'review' to the create-table enum fixes sqlite and is harmless on pgsql (the later ALTER rewrites the constraint anyway). Verified via migrate:fresh --seed on PostgreSQL.
- tests/Feature/ManualPaymentFlowTest.php (NEW): RefreshDatabase, sqlite style like RegistrationTest. Covers: register -> role 'customer' + GET /dashboard 200; GET /booking/{booking}/pay 200 showing config('payment.bank.account_number'); bank_transfer checkout (Storage::fake + UploadedFile::fake image) -> status 'review', Payment (bank_transfer, pending), proof stored + proof_of_payment set; on_site checkout -> status 'review', Payment (on_site, pending), no proof; approve replication -> booking active + room occupied + Payment success + verified_at; reject replication -> booking pending + Payment failed + notes + room NOT occupied.

VERIFICATION:
- php artisan test --filter=ManualPaymentFlowTest: 6 passed (32 assertions).
- php artisan test: ManualPaymentFlowTest + all booking/auth/profile tests pass. 4 PRE-EXISTING failures unrelated to FEAT-003 (Tests\Feature\Auth\PasswordResetTest x3 and Tests\Feature\ExampleTest x1); confirmed they fail identically with FEAT-003 edits stashed, so they are not regressions from this feature.
- php artisan migrate:fresh --seed: all migrations + seeders (AdminUserSeeder, RoomSeeder, BookingSeeder, ReviewSeeder) complete green on PostgreSQL.
